name: pre-story-mechanism-placement-proof
title: Define a pre-story Mechanism Placement Proof gate for Proof-or-Stop
description: Write an audited architecture decision for a mandatory focused-research proof before Story ID allocation. Extend existing STORY_INTAKE and ProofStory mechanisms instead of introducing a parallel lifecycle. Define fail-closed verdicts, freshness and binding rules, rollout, implementation touchpoints, and a B-3783/root-npm-test worked example, then incorporate independent Claude CLI and agy CLI audits.
